description: Source code for a customized ConfigParser class used in the Kivy framework, including configuration management, version upgrades, environment variable handling, and default settings initialization.

classes.name: ConfigParser
classes.description: Enhanced ConfigParser class supporting default sections, callbacks, and named instances, used for managing Kivy configuration settings.

methods.name: add_callback
methods.description: Registers a callback to be invoked when a specific section or key changes.

methods.name: _do_callbacks
methods.description: Internal method to execute registered callbacks upon changes.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads configuration from a specified file, triggering callbacks on changes.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a configuration option, converting the value to string and invoking callbacks.

methods.name: setall
methods.description: Sets multiple key-value pairs in a section.

methods.name: setdefaults
methods.description: Sets multiple default key-value pairs in a section.

methods.name: setdefault
methods.description: Sets a default value for an option if it does not exist.

methods.name: getdefault
methods.description: Gets an option value or returns a default if not present.

methods.name: getdefaultint
methods.description: Gets an integer option value or returns a default.

methods.name: adddefaultsection
methods.description: Adds a section if it does not already exist.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes the current configuration to the last read file.

methods.name: update_config
methods.description: Upgrades configuration based on a new default config file, optionally overwriting existing values.
